verdict.rationale: Check documents the payroll lifecycle of creating, previewing and approving a payroll object through its API (check-docs-3). It also lists embeddable Components that let users run payroll (check-docs-11) and an MCP server that can run payroll (check-docs-21). However, a single ops-facing UI flow covering review, preview and submission is only mentioned briefly, and reviewing hours and earnings is not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of hours/earnings review, detailed docs of the Run Payroll component flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
